questions.reason: Needs every unordered pair of manufacturers present in the same order, i.e. part joined to itself through lineitem/orders. The shared model has one part role, and an AQL explore cannot produce two independent manufacturer columns over the same order (no self-join or cross join of a model). Hard-coding one dimension per manufacturer value would pivot to columns, not the 10 requested rows, and would rely on knowing the 5 values.
